_comment: Third-party test PDFs, not tracked in git. pnpm fixtures:fetch (scripts/fetch-fixtures.mjs) downloads source=upstream files from their url, builds source=derived files with the named tool, and fetches source=private-mirror files by their content-addressed mirrorKey (fixtures/<sha256>/<name>) from the private S3 mirror (DOCSLURP_ASSET_MIRROR + DOCSLURP_ASSET_S3_*, read-only key; see docs/licensing.md). Everything lands in the gitignored cache <repo>/.cache/fixtures/pdf (or $DOCSLURP_CACHE_DIR). Every file is verified by size + sha256. Synthetic fixtures generated by worker/testdata/pdf-fixtures/generate-fixtures.mjs stay in git and are not listed here.

privateMirror.note: envBaseUrl is a legacy plain-HTTP fallback.
